create_FrameRateCounter: create a FrameRateCounter instance to measure frame rates with a sliding window of 5 records
start_FrameRateCounter: start the FrameRateCounter timer by calling the start method to record the start time
stop_FrameRateCounter: stop the FrameRateCounter timer and return instantaneous and average frame rates as floats
reset_FrameRateCounter: reset the FrameRateCounter state to zero out all counters and clear the sliding window
review_FrameRateCounter_window_average: review the FrameRateCounter sliding window logic that computes average FPS over the last 5 frame timings
